    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        total_sum = sum(a)
        if total_sum % n != 0:
            results.append('-1')
            continue
        target = total_sum // n
        operations = []
        for i in range(n):
            while a[i] > target:
                diff = a[i] - target
                found = False
                for j in range(n):
                    if a[j] < target:
                        x = min(diff, (target - a[j]) // (i + 1))
                        if x > 0:
                            a[i] -= x * (i + 1)
                            a[j] += x * (i + 1)
                            operations.append(f"{i + 1} {j + 1} {x}")
                            found = True
                            break
                if not found:
                    results.append('-1')
                    break
            if results[-1] == '-1':
                break
        else:
            results.append(str(len(operations)))
            results.extend(operations)
    print('\n'.join(results))

main()
